executive_summary: Demand signals from founder interviews and one regional report support a pilot, but competitor pricing and unit economics remain unverified.

supporting_evidence.statement: 9 of 12 interviewed remote workers skip lunch or order fast food.

assumptions.statement: 990 RUB per lunch is acceptable for target segment.

evidence_gaps: Kitchen partner availability and margin structure

market_signals.statement: Prepared meal delivery growing in Siberia per fictional regional report.

customer_fit_findings.statement: Remote professionals with limited lunch prep time are plausible early adopters.

commercial_risks.title: Unverified unit economics
commercial_risks.description: Subscription price may not cover kitchen and delivery costs.

operational_risks.title: Founder-operated delivery scale
operational_risks.description: Pilot delivery may not scale without operational partners.

recommended_action: Run a constrained pilot with 20 subscribers before launch pack preparation.
next_validation_steps: Sign LOI with one kitchen partner
